title: Bearing bore diameters (confidence interval)
intro: Sixteen bearing housings were taken from a day's production and their bore diameters measured. The bores are machined to 25.000 mm. The sample mean was 25.004 mm and the sample standard deviation 0.008 mm. The 95 % confidence interval is a range of plausible values for the mean bore of the whole day's production. Module 7 teaches confidence intervals fully.
